# ReadAnyDoc

> Open-source document parsing and extraction on vision models (Claude Haiku 5.5 by default): typed blocks, tables, Markdown, form fields, word-level citations, extraction into your own schema. A Python library and a Reducto-compatible HTTP server. Apache-2.0, built by Unmute.

## Use
- [Agent setup](AGENT_SETUP.md): step-by-step instructions for a coding agent to install and wire it into a project
- [MCP server](https://arpitpatel25.github.io/ReadAnyDoc/docs/get-started/mcp/): `readanydoc mcp`, parse and extract as tools
- [README](README.md): install, parse, extract into a pydantic class, modes, model choice, CLI, server
- [Examples](examples/): runnable scripts
- [Library reference](readanydoc/library.py): every argument and result type
- [Documentation](https://arpitpatel25.github.io/ReadAnyDoc/docs/): guides, API reference, configuration, migrating from Reducto

## Results
- [Benchmarks](BENCHMARKS.md): against Reducto r-1 and the plain model on olmOCR-bench, OmniDocBench, RD-TableBench, FUNSD and long-document extraction
- [Per-document scores](results/README.md)
